name: Howard Poole
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember being called madam by somebody older than my mother.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Howard by a small Tuesday habit. Howard notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I had been addressing her as madam for eighteen years. She invited me to tea as her younger self.
appearance: Howard has heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a rust-colored canvas coat with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Howard turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Howard gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Howard privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To visit the founder without the office honorific.
family: Chris Lowe is Howard’s cousin. Howard chooses an ordinary story to tell. Chris asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *A closing hour*, Chris says, “I own the rival laundry. I offered to take the regulars for one day and give them back on Monday.”
connections: Rowan Katz (trust founder). Founder and secretary can now meet under the easier childhood name.
